lesson: The twist relation is a property of the character and holds for every pair lift, so a pair functional that consumes it exactly cancels the prime side and leaves an archimedean form. Functionals of the ratio are blind to common multipliers (T-NR at split primes). Sign (comparison in every window) and size (density in q) compose formally in Lemma A, but the comparison link is equivalent to the target and on all but q^(theta+eps) twists is the scalar zeta statement.
